verdict.rationale: Teller's first-party docs describe webhooks it sends when conditions or changes occur in user enrollments or their financial data, registered by pointing Teller at a URL in your app. That covers the core of subscribing to events, though the pack only shows configuration through the Teller Dashboard rather than programmatically. Missing for 10: documented list of event types, signature verification, retry/delivery semantics, API-based (non-dashboard) webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
